chapter: Buddy Petit's death, Milneburg and halls
title: Miracle Hall, San Jacinto Hall and other venues
summary: Discussion of halls where Penn played with Rena and Buddy Petit, and venues he never played.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: And you never played at the Miracle Round? Yeah, the Miracle Round, yes.
The Miracle Round. On Hickory Street?
That's, I don't know. Hickory and there.
Yes I played there. I played there after they had a parade for some club to give a dance there one Sunday. Tilma was playing with us. Wilma Tilma?
Yeah. Is that the same clubhouse they have down here now? It doesn't have any building on it. It's open? Oh right now, I'm playing open.

Years back we used to play at the San Suu, you know, you remember the San Suu Hall? Yeah. How about that? Well we played there many times too, Randy and Buddy P.T. played the heavy bands there all the time. That's old time, that's a long time ago you know. That hall's still there.
Yeah but they don't have any more dancers there.
I walked in there, it's a pool, they got pool tables in there. The hall looks in good shape here. Yeah. Good cypress.
Yeah, right back in that courtyard there. Yeah that's right. That's right. Looks in good shape here. You never have played at Booker Hill?
No I don't remember playing there. That's the Calton section.
No. By the river. I've heard Johnny St. Cyr talk about that.
By the Bunch of Hills. Yeah. No I knew. Did you play there Manuel?
